_comment: THE AUTHORITATIVE LINT BASELINE, in machine-readable form.
ENGINEERING_PLAYBOOK M-105 requires lint to be reported as a delta against
a known baseline, never as an absolute count. This file is that baseline, so
no operator has to know or type the current number: the release validator
Lowering it is a reviewed repository change, made in the same pull request as
the lint debt it retires — which is what keeps the baseline authoritative.
Raising it is a regression and is not an acceptable way to make a run pass.
